data.name: Irtiqa
data.gender_notes: Irtiqa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name that represents the idea of transformation and change, inspiring individuals to evolve and grow. The name Irtiqa carries the meaning “Change and transformation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Irtiqa usually hope their child will grow to embody change and transformation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Quranic context, Irtiqa symbolizes spiritual growth and transformation, reminding us to always strive for self-improvement.
data.etymology: Irtiqa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Change and transformation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Irtiqa total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: ارتقاء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث و مذكر في اللغة العربية، مشتق من الفعل ارتقى، ويعني الارتقاء إلى أعلى المراتب والدرجات، والتقدم في العلم والمعرفة، والوصول إلى مراتب عالية في الدنيا والآخرة. ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر آية ૨٥ {وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ رُسُلاً وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ أَزْوَاجاً وَذُرِّيَةً وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِيَ بِآيَةٍ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِ اللّهِ}.

in_urdu.name: ارتقا
in_urdu.meaning: اعلیٰ مقامات و مرتبت تک پہنچنا، ترقی کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربى زبان سے ماخوذ، ارتقا کا مطلب ہے اعلیٰ مقامات و مرتبت تک پہنچنا، ترقی کرنا، اور علم و معرفت میں پیش رفت کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ روحانی ترقی اور پیش رفت کی یاد دلاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इरतिका
in_hindi.meaning: उच्चतम पदों और श्रेणियों तक पहुँचना, प्रगति करना
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है उच्चतम पदों और श्रेणियों तक पहुँचना, प्रगति करना, और ज्ञान में आगे बढ़ना। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक उन्नति और विकास की याद दिलाता है।

in_pashto.name: ارتقا
in_pashto.long_meaning: د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی، ارتقا معنی لوړوالیو ته رسیدل، پرمختګ کول، او په علم او پوهه کې پرمختګ کول. دا نوم په اسلامي کیلنڈر کې اهمیت لري ځکه چې دا روحاني پرمختګ او پرمختګ ته اشاره کوي.

in_english.name: Irtiqa
in_english.meaning: ascending to higher ranks and degrees, progressing
in_english.long_meaning: The name Irtiqa originates from Arabic, derived from the verb 'irtiqa', which means to ascend to higher ranks and degrees, to progress in knowledge and understanding, and to reach high levels of spiritual growth. The term finds its roots in the Arabic concept of spiritual advancement and ascension. In Islamic tradition, Irtiqa symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge, spiritual growth, and ascending to higher levels of righteousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Irtiqa" holds a unique significance in Islamic culture, as it symbolizes the journey towards a better self and a more enlightened society. It is a name that inspires individuals to seek knowledge, challenge their comfort zones, and strive for continuous improvement. The name is often associated with notions of progress, change, and development, both on an individual and collective level.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, "Irtiqa" is a reminder of the continual process of self-improvement and transformation that is central to the Islamic faith. The name is derived from the Arabic root "r-t-q," which means "to strive towards" or "to seek," emphasizing the personal effort and dedication required to live a virtuous life. By invoking the spirit of "Irtiqa," individuals are encouraged to embrace the challenges and opportunities that come their way and to remain steadfast on the path of self-betterment and spiritual growth. Ultimately, the name "Irtiqa" serves as a powerful call to action, reminding us all to continually seek knowledge, wisdom, and inner peace, and to bring about positive change in ourselves, in our communities, and in the world at large.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Change and transformation" symbolizes A name that represents the idea of transformation and change, inspiring individuals to evolve and grow.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Irtiqa serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of change and transformation.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Irtiqa was a title given to a high-ranking official in the Abbasid Caliphate. The name Irtiqa carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The Abbasid Caliphate was a major political and cultural power in the Islamic world during this period.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Irtiqa remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
